FILE references/platforms.md
# 平台适配

以下是接入方法，不表示 runner 已经自动适配所有原生工程。工程命令、测试宿主、输出位置和测量代码需由 agent 从当前项目确认或生成。runner 只执行 profile 中的真实参数数组。

## 选择执行路径

| 项目 | 组件反馈 | 页面集成 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Android Compose | 已有 compose-ai-tools/Preview 优先；也可使用项目已有 Paparazzi | 现有 Android UI/E2E 工具、模拟器 |
| Android XML/Views | Paparazzi，继承工程资源与主题 | 现有 instrumentation/UI 工具 |
| iOS SwiftUI | SnapshotTesting 测试宿主；已有可用预览工具时可复用 | 实际 App + 已确认的模拟器控制工具 |
| iOS UIKit/Objective-C | SnapshotTesting 创建真实 View/VC；需要时用 Swift 测试宿主调用已有模块 | 实际 App + 已确认的模拟器控制工具 |

组件无法隔离、依赖系统能力或构建版本不兼容时，可改用现有页面截图路径，backend 填 simulator。该名称只标记执行路径，不额外安装或提供设备控制能力。

## Android Compose

复用已有 @Preview、主题和 fixture；新增 Preview 也应调用生产 Composable。不要以重新绘制一个近似组件代替实际生产组件。

compose-ai-tools 的 CLI 可渲染 Preview 并输出 PNG、布局等信息。先读取当前安装版本的 help，确认 list/render 的筛选与输出参数，再生成 profile。将输出定向到本次 {output} 下，避免把旧缓存图当作本轮已渲染的证据。其构建版本要求需逐项核对，不为普通 UI 改动自动升级旧工程。

已有 Paparazzi 时沿用它即可，不要求同时安装两种组件渲染器。

## Android Paparazzi / View / XML

确认 Gradle wrapper、AGP、JDK、Paparazzi 版本以及实际 module/variant。测试 source set 中调用真实 Composable 或加载真实 XML/View，沿用资源、字体、主题及生产数据绑定入口。

普通 test task 可用于生成渲染报告；verifyPaparazzi<Variant> 用于已有 golden 的回归。使用当前项目支持的单用例筛选方式，检查原生报告确实执行了对应测试。

capture profile 的实际图片 glob 要指向该用例的一张 actual 图，不能笼统收集整份报告中的实际图、参考图和差异图。确认当前版本的报告目录。首轮可使用 Gradle 的 --rerun-tasks 强制产生本轮产物；后续优化缓存时必须保留输入与缓存命中的可追溯证据。

recordPaparazzi<Variant> 会写 golden。验证流程使用普通渲染/verify；需要生成候选 golden 时在单独的临时工程目录中执行并收集候选，不把新图直接覆盖已批准基准。

数值检查额外生成 measurements.json。标准 View 可测量宿主坐标系中的实际边界，TextView 可按具体文本、主题和富文本覆盖读取有效样式。Compose 的语义树不保证提供所有绘制属性；可使用渲染器实际提供的测量数据或针对性测试，缺失时保留 needs_review。

### 真实工程接入时的检查

本仓库 Reply 试验使用 Paparazzi 的 HtmlReportWriter 导出实际图，从本轮 run 报告确认测试名和图片路径，并核对 JUnit XML 恰好执行了目标测试。不要假设 Android Kotlin 测试编译环境能直接引用 java.awt.BufferedImage 来实现自定义截图 handler。设备配置的物理尺寸也不一定等于导出 PNG 尺寸，须解码实际文件确认。

检查项目主题中的窗口副作用。LocalInspectionMode 与 View.isInEditMode 是两个独立条件；仅设置前者不保证能跳过 context as Activity。本次 Reply 在测试宿主提供 Preview 环境和 isInEditMode 为 true 的 LocalView，调用原有主题及生产组件；窗口行为另由真实 Activity 验证。将这种环境差异明确记入 profile，不能据此声明组件宿主覆盖了窗口行为。

存在现成 modifier 参数时，可在测试调用点增加 onGloballyPositioned，读取实际 LayoutCoordinates，无需修改生产组件或增加业务 ID。说明测量包含哪层 modifier；外层尺寸不能直接称为内部 padding、文字字号或字形边界。

Reply 新增附件摘要的试验还在 Compose 1.9.4 的测试宿主中，从真实 LocalView 对应 ViewRootForTest 获取 semanticsOwner.unmergedRootSemanticsNode，按实际文字筛选节点，读取 boundsInRoot 和 GetTextLayoutResult。后者对本次普通 Text 提供 layoutInput.style 的字号/颜色及 isLineEllipsized，成功测得 14sp/12sp、当前主题 ARGB、文字框间距和省略状态。需要确认当前版本 API、读取时机及采样对象；这不是通用完整样式树，不能据此推断富文本 run、brush、绘制覆盖或所有 Compose 版本也提供同样数据。

## iOS SnapshotTesting

确认 workspace/project、scheme、测试 target、SDK/部署版本、实际模拟器标识与已安装 SnapshotTesting API。将依赖添加到测试 target，继承现有 UIKit/SwiftUI 架构。

UIKit 创建真实 View/VC 并运行实际配置入口，完成布局后截图。SwiftUI 使用承载真实 View 的测试宿主，注入主题、状态、字体及环境。涉及导航、安全区或生命周期时使用相应父容器。

建议测试宿主将本轮实际图片输出到 NATIVE_UI_OUTPUT；这是本包装层约定的环境变量，不是 SnapshotTesting 自带的图片输出开关。可在测试代码中使用已确认版本的 Snapshotting 图片策略捕获 UIImage 并写入该目录；不要仅设置变量就假设框架会导出图片。

必须在测试宿主内确认输出变量实际可读。runner 设置父进程环境，不保证 Xcode/模拟器或其他测试 worker 自动继承；使用当前工程确认可用的测试计划、环境配置或适配脚本传递。无法传递时，用已验证的测试附件导出流程产生本轮图片。iOS 示例 profile 只展示 xcodebuild 参数结构，不包含这个工程专用桥接。

复用现有 assertSnapshot 测试时，普通验证应使用当前版本的非记录策略，并从实际 xcresult/测试附件中导出 actual 图。仅有引用图片或截图路径文字不足以证明本轮产生了 actual。图片导出的具体命令需根据已安装 Xcode 的 xcresulttool help 确认。

新组件缺少基准时，候选录制与正式 golden 使用独立目录。正式参考和实际候选分开，记录模式导致的原生测试失败不能被当作整套构建通过；需要单独的候选捕获入口。

精确测量需在测试宿主额外实现。UIKit 的 frame、bounds、文字绘制范围、layoutMargins 和约束常量不是同一事实；统一坐标系，注明测量含义。颜色应解析当前 trait/主题和富文本覆盖，字体应区分默认字体与实际文本 run。SwiftUI 没有由本 Skill 提供的通用完整样式树。

本仓库 AlertToast 试验采用 build-for-testing 生成 xctestrun，在目标测试的 EnvironmentVariables 中写入本轮输出路径及场景，再 test-without-building。复制 xctestrun 到证据目录时，要保留 __TESTROOT__ 对原构建产物目录的含义。此方法已在试验使用的 Xcode 27.1 验证；其他版本先读本机 xctestrun 文档并确认格式。核对 xcresult 的目标测试、执行数及失败数，并确认测试宿主实际写出了本轮 PNG；仅 xcodebuild 成功不足以证明目标测试执行。

## iOS 原生观测与受控状态

单测 UIHostingController 可以生成图片，但不能假设其 AX 树或点击链路与实际 App 相同。需要这些证据时，使用 [iOS observer 契约](../assets/ios-observer/CONTRACT.md)接入真实生产包/组件，再运行 `scripts/ios_observe.py`。先在独立简单探针中验证真实 AX、回调、调用方更新和完整滚动；适配器会生成薄 App 与 XCUITest，不会生成业务组件。

桥接层负责将真实回调交给调用方并按组件原契约更新数据。验证父级替换输入时保留被测 View 身份；重建页面/重新启动的两个状态不能证明同一实例收到更新。记录实际环境、进程、采样位置与事件差值。AX 框、原生触控框、图片中的字形框分开解释；AX 没有暴露的 SwiftUI 字号/颜色/padding 不能被包装成已读出的属性。

同样，Android 截图结束后调用旧语义闭包，只能证明该闭包当时被调用；不能证明仍挂载的组件完成重组。状态型需求需要连续挂载的采集或 instrumentation，先验证当前渲染器的帧循环及状态更新，未执行的部分保留待评估。

## 页面反馈

有 MobileBuildMCP、agent-device、项目既有 UI/E2E 工具时，使用已验证存在的能力来构建、启动、导航和截图；没有相应工具时不编造调用名称。固定页面状态并确认截图中是本次目标，再把对应命令包装进 profile。

组件检查与页面检查分别报告。布局在独立宿主中通过，不能自动证明页面中的滚动、键盘、导航和点击正确。

# Requirement decisions and source-bound feedback

Use this for a complex UI change when findings need to drive implementation and
verification decisions. The tools reuse existing observations; they do not infer
generic computed SwiftUI styles or automatically prove root causes.

## Approved obligations and launch inputs

The independent design source JSON includes an obligation index. Every entry has
exactly `id`, `clause`, `priority` (`must`/`advisory`), `states` (approved state IDs)
and `risk` (`layout`/`style`/`behavior`/`content`). The owner must check that this index
represents the intended requirements; hashing cannot prove prose completeness.

An independently approved routes file has this shape:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "index": {"source": "reference", "pointer": "/obligations"},
  "routes": {
    "action-state": {
      "rule_ids": ["primary-enabled", "activation-receipt"],
      "reason": "Native control plus successfully dispatched callback checks",
      "regression_obligations": ["action-appearance"]
    },
    "action-appearance": {
      "rule_ids": ["primary-fill"],
      "reason": "Approved rendered region",
      "regression_obligations": []
    }
  }
}
```

Every index obligation needs a disposition; unknown rule IDs are rejected. An empty
route retains its rationale, and a MUST without an applicable route blocks release.
Independently declared N/A cells stay N/A. An outside-ledger discovery is not an
automatic false alarm: check whether the original requirement lacks a route.

Each case/platform also has a JSON launch record inside a source in the design
lock: exactly `scenario`, `platform`, `fixtures_sha256` (canonical JSON digest) and
`bridge_sha256` (original file-byte SHA). This pins actual caller inputs and the
thin bridge independently from implementation. Record its exact source/pointer.

```sh
python3 scripts/requirement_routes.py audit --plan plan.json \
  --design-lock lock.json --design-sha256 LOCK_SHA \
  --routes routes.json --routes-sha256 ROUTES_SHA --output coverage.json
```

`route` takes the same arguments plus `--report` and `--observation`. Its output
separates contract-route repair, missing capture, environment repair, oracle
disagreement, source diagnosis and unresolved capability/locator investigations.
Optional `--discoveries` accepts original `{obligation_id,reason,evidence}` records;
it does not turn them into TP/FP or extend their detection scope.

## Compile one execution manifest

`execution_plan.py` reconstructs the approved business route and after-target
extensions from the parent design plan. It does not accept a separate base action
file as an equivalent route. Full executions retain business actions. Targeted
feedback keeps the original action prefix/indices through its last selected state,
omits only unrequested observation work, and retains the complete parent plan and
expectations. Initial states need explicit approved checkpoint actions.

```sh
python3 scripts/execution_plan.py --plan plan.json \
  --design-lock lock.json --design-sha256 LOCK_SHA \
  --fixtures approved-fixtures.json --bridge Bridge.swift \
  --launch-source launch --launch-pointer /caseA/ios \
  --state expanded --state updated --output feedback-plan
```

Without `--state` the manifest requests full coverage. It writes `execution.json`,
derived runtime `fixtures.json` and `actions.json`. `--strategy legacy` is a neutral
comparison option; optimized execution defaults to `coalesced`.

Add `--run --execution feedback-plan/execution.json --source-root /actual/component/source`
and the normal platform options (`--package`, `--simulator`, `--developer-dir`,
`--build-cache` for iOS; `--project`, `--java-home`, `--android-sdk` for Android),
using a DIFFERENT fresh output directory. Source roots are explicit production
files/folders, not generated test/build folders. Evidence must be outside them.
The runner rebuilds the manifest, records source/input fingerprints before SDK
execution, checks them afterward, and immediately computes required coverage and
automatic parent-plan checks. `--policy` and `--policy-sha256` enable bound pixel
checks without qualitative votes. Each failed attempt has its own fresh directory.

Source identity is a changed-root fingerprint, not a complete compiler dependency
proof. The integration owner must choose actual relevant production roots. Test
environments, locked fixture/bridge bytes and real dispatch still need preflight.

The iOS coalesced mode uses each fresh full-state scan for its target observations,
reads coverage facts from that same AX/image packet, and omits unrequested auxiliary
initial/before-update/final scans. It keeps native activation, immediate frames,
settling waits, interval coverage and epoch checks. It does not reuse an old image
across code/state changes. Operation timings are nested inclusive walls, not additive
elapsed time. `captured_partial` is collection success within a targeted scope,
not complete business/visual acceptance.

## Recheck a change

`retest_plan.py` consumes an evaluated parent report, original failed assertion IDs,
approved obligation dependencies, changed production paths and before/after source
SHA digests. It closes the declared regression dependencies and proposes selected
states for diagnostic feedback. It does not prove that all other states are safe.

```sh
python3 scripts/retest_plan.py --coverage coverage.json --plan plan.json \
  --report original-report.json --failed-id expanded/primary-fill \
  --change change.json --output retest.json
```

`change.json` contains `changed_files`, `source_before` and `source_after`. Keep the
original finding, source cause hypothesis and minimal patch, then use this plan to
obtain new evidence. Select a project precedent for the affected component/style
when appropriate; retain its actual source location and deployment constraints.
Do not replace the independent design with an implementation-derived expectation.

After diagnostic feedback, perform a fresh FULL final run and required page/E2E
checks. `requirement_routes.py admit` consumes the evaluated complete parent report
and returns blocking MUST obligations. `--scope targeted` can never return accepted.
An unavailable critical style or disputed oracle is unverified, not fixed.

For normal development, run checks as soon as a source-bound capture is ready.
Record queue/synchronization separately from compile/native/check/agent work.
Research trials additionally isolate arms and seal every source version and all
external/heldout judgments; global cohort barriers are not a daily PR workflow.

For measured change selection, use `retest_plan.py --capture-result <original/result.json>
--capture-result-sha256 <independently retained file SHA> --source-root <same original roots>
--coverage coverage.json --plan plan.json --failed-id <original failed id> --output retest.json`.
The tool verifies the original report and before/after capture maps, derives changed
files and source identity from actual current files, and rejects swapped roots or
edited reports. The independently retained result digest must come from the trusted
capture record. Legacy `--report --change` mode labels its change identity as caller
declared; it is not measured source evidence. Neither mode proves a source impact
graph or waives full fresh final verification.

`admit` also requires a verified full source-bound capture and actual environment P
before returning accepted; all-P requirement rows alone are insufficient. Without
those proofs it returns not_accepted. For the original automatic result, supply
`--capture-result result.json --capture-result-sha256 RETAINED_SHA --environment
approved-environment.json --environment-sha256 APPROVED_CANONICAL_SHA`; the CLI
rechecks original observation/report bytes and actual native environment. Manual
MUSTs still await the approved evidence-based review path. An upstream independent
acceptance evaluator may call the library with its recomputed consensus report,
verified capture receipt and recomputed environment; a self-entered report or
receipt is not certified by this function.

The unified run can also take `--environment approved-environment.json
--environment-sha256 APPROVED_CANONICAL_SHA`. It checks the independently fixed
schema before SDK launch, recomputes actual environment from collected native
packets, and attaches that result to automatic findings for routing. An invalid
observed environment blocks verified capture; it is an environment-repair action,
not evidence for production-code churn. This reuses existing runtime facts and
adds no screenshot or scan. Without this option the capture makes no environment
validation claim; admission still requires environment P.

For targeted observations, add `route --execution execution.json --fixtures
original-approved-fixtures.json --bridge original-bridge` to verify the exact
selected scope from the independent plan. Unrequested U rows become
`defer_to_full_verification`, not locator/capability investigations; real supported
failures remain actionable. A targeted packet without its verified manifest asks
for scope validation before missing-state diagnosis. These dispositions retain
all parent U rows and never waive the required full final run.

A visual failure can use the same measured-source path: add `--review-submission
original-actuals.json --review-sha256 RETAINED_FILE_SHA --design-lock lock.json
--design-sha256 APPROVED_LOCK_SHA --policy policy.json --policy-sha256 APPROVED_POLICY_SHA`.
The tool rebinds the original visual actuals and recomputes the report from the
original capture/contract; it still rejects arbitrary replacement reports, edited
images, foreign review IDs, unchanged source and mismatched source namespaces.
A visual judgment remains a judgment, not native computed style or root-cause truth.

# Native control and per-state observation tools

Use these when a component needs native interaction, long-content location or visual
checks across caller updates. The adapters invoke the caller's production bridge;
they supply no business UI or expected answer. Run generic capability probes first.

## Capture

The iOS App/XCUITest entry point remains `scripts/ios_observe.py run` (see the
[full bridge contract](../assets/ios-observer/CONTRACT.md)). `state_capture` defaults
to true. Its caller JSON has `initial`, optional `updates`, finite offered width160–1024pt (verify actual viewport), theme,
Dynamic Type category, direction, and optional `observation_targets` selectors.

The Android entry point requires an existing Paparazzi test project, its JVM/SDK
configuration and a caller bridge in package `org.nativeobserver`:

```kotlin
object ObserverBridge {
  @Composable fun Content(input: JsonObject, onEvent: (String) -> Unit) {
    // Decode input, apply the project's real theme, call the production component.
    // Echo controlled actions in the caller bridge and notify onEvent.
  }
}
```

```sh
python3 scripts/android_observe.py run --project /absolute/project \
  --bridge /absolute/ObserverBridge.kt --fixtures /absolute/fixtures.json \
  --actions /absolute/actions.json --output /absolute/fresh-output \
  --java-home /absolute/jdk --android-sdk /absolute/sdk
```

The Android config uses width, theme, fontScale, direction, initial and updates.
The adapter adds a newly created reserved test folder, removes only its own files
in `finally`, and retains exact sources, inputs, JUnit, images and hashes in output.
It does not install Gradle plugins or claim Activity/physical-touch coverage.

Both action formats support:

```json
[
  {"type":"tap","target":{"identifier":"actual.choice"},"reveal":true,
   "allow_disabled":true,"state_id":"selected"},
  {"type":"apply_next_fixture","state_id":"replaced"},
  {"type":"tap","target":{"label":"Exact visible action","role":"button"},
   "reveal":true,"state_id":"after-action"},
  {"type":"sweep","state_id":"expanded"}
]
```

After a tap, the observer keeps the immediate result and, by default, reveals the
same target again if layout moved it outside the viewport. `after_target` can name
another exact selector; `observe_after:false` explicitly disables that extra
observation. No second activation occurs. Post-observation stores target geometry,
snapshot and input/event binding; offscreen/missing/ambiguous targets or binding
drift never become a visual pass. A fitting target is fully revealed; an oversized
target's center is measured separately from full visibility.

For multiple locations use `after_targets:[selector,...]` on a tap, caller update
or checkpoint. Native observers reuse already valid frames and collect remaining
targets without another activation. `observation_max_scrolls` (0–40, default24)
bounds the entire target set, not each target. Missing/ambiguous targets retain
their individual unavailable result; a zero search budget still permits actual
immediate-frame facts. `observation_set` binds original snapshot indices, input,
process and event revision, plus native target results and geometry traces.
Callback receipts and event_end remain those of the immediate action frame.
Read [state evidence planning](state-evidence.md) for matrix compilation and
machine findings; `coverage:"targets"` evaluates all bound frames while retaining
`complete:false`. It also gives legacy single-frame evidence its actual credit.

iOS exports hierarchy/attributes from one public XCUIElementSnapshot per capture.
Native hit testing is queried at actual dispatch targets; other exported nodes
have `hittable_measured:false`, not guessed hit values. A native epoch/geometry
change across hierarchy and image makes that capture unassessed. Reveal navigation
keeps native geometry traces; `trace_reveal_images:true` also keeps every search
image. Full-content sweeps still retain all required overlapping images.

For repeated fixtures on unchanged source, iOS `run --build-cache /absolute/cache`
can reuse a content-addressed compiled host. The key covers source/bridge/templates,
toolchain, SDK and compile options; artifact hashes are checked before reuse. Each
capture gets a fresh runtime test plan, inputs, App process, callbacks and images.
Changed code/toolchain is a miss; changed/tampered artifacts fail closed. The manifest
separates cache validation/build, native test and export time. Android retains one
attached ComposeView and stops only when its native capture state machine completes;
it does not shorten content or omit planned states to meet the frame budget.

Selectors are exact identifier or exact label with an optional native role. Natural
language target selection remains the caller agent's job. Duplicate semantic
matches or multiple native actionable descendants are unavailable, never first-match
clicks. iOS uses actual descendant queries; Android uses actual semantic parent IDs.
The semantic container retains coherent label/selected traits, while enabled state
and activation use the unique actual Button/Switch/OnClick. Independently activatable
parents and children remain separate candidates; a narrower selector is required.
Only native Switch wrapper/leaf duplication is collapsed. A container's `enabled=true`
or an ordinary Button's `selected=false` alone is not a component defect.

Long-content location uses current native frames and bounded feedback. iOS reduces
scroll size on direction reversals and records missing/stationary/limit outcomes.
Normal-sized iOS controls are revealed completely. A scroll-to-text target does not
require a control role. An oversized native control may be activated at its measured visible intersection;
that is recorded separately from full-element visibility, with real callback delta.
Android invokes the native semantic action and moves native ScrollState; this is
not OS physical touch. Missing callbacks after an unexecuted action stay unassessed.

## State coverage

Capture automatically sweeps initial, before caller replacement, and final. Give
relevant post-action checkpoints unique `state_id` values to sweep those states too.
`initial`/`final` are reserved. Explicit sweep `max_steps` can bound one sweep; the
result remains incomplete if that bound cannot cover the content.

Each `state_captures` item binds input index/hash, process/session identity, event
revision, action checkpoint and exact snapshot indices. Native content geometry
and viewport intervals establish top-to-bottom overlap for THAT state. A later
fixture's footer cannot fill an earlier fixture's gap. No global observed-ID union
is substituted for per-state coverage. Dynamic content/height/binding problems stay
visible. Complete pixel coverage is not style correctness.

XCUI sometimes returns non-finite geometry. JSON transport retains those coordinates
as null and lists their native values/paths in `serialization_diagnostics`; their
pixel projection is unavailable. It never substitutes zero coordinates or drops all
other native observations because one frame cannot be represented in JSON.

## Typed assertions

`native_checks.py` consumes a frozen atomic plan and actual observation. Keep a
requirement's independently unmeasured aspects separate. The independent required-ID
set can detect omitted plan cells; code cannot prove that natural-language intent
has been completely translated into the plan.

```json
{
 "version":1,
 "states":[{"id":"selected","input_index":0,"after_action":0}],
 "required_assertion_ids":["choice-enabled","selected-state"],
 "assertions":[
  {"id":"choice-enabled","state":"selected","kind":"control",
   "target":{"identifier":"actual.choice"},"property":"enabled","expected":true},
  {"id":"selected-state","state":"selected","kind":"control",
   "target":{"identifier":"actual.choice"},"property":"selected","expected":true}
 ]
}
```

```sh
python3 scripts/native_checks.py --plan /absolute/plan.json \
  --observation /absolute/capture/observation.json --platform ios \
  --output /absolute/fresh-checks.json
```

For an action-only checkpoint, a state can set `coverage:"target"` and
`after_action:N`. The checker verifies the exact native post-action snapshot and
binding, without a full sweep. Its `complete:false` explicitly means no full-content
claim. It can establish callback/native-control assertions, while a full-content
visual pass remains withheld. Use this to avoid expensive unnecessary whole-body
sweeps after every simple interaction.

Control properties include present, unique, enabled, selected, value, label,
control_role, ax_width/ax_height. `touch_width/touch_height` use Android native touch
bounds only; iOS AX frames do not establish physical hit regions. `event` assertions
name the action index and exact expected callback delta. They default to activation
and the platform's real route (`xcui_tap` or `compose_onclick`). Optional
`required_method` must match the demonstrated method. The exported
`native_checks.callback_verdict` is also the evaluator entry point: successful
attempt, unique enabled native control, same input/process and exact event interval
are hard preconditions. Observer-blocked/unavailable/observed intervals remain U
even when expected callbacks are empty. A demonstrated delivery with missing/wrong
callbacks is F. For callback quietness after caller replacement, explicitly set
`stimulus:"caller_update"`; the native input index must demonstrably advance by one.
Literal interval facts are retained separately and are not behavior verdicts.
`text_layout` uses exported
native text-layout fields such as font_sp, color_argb, lines, ellipsized or overflow;
unsupported fields remain unassessed, not guessed from source.

A `manual` visual/pixel assertion requires a review with `observation_sha256` and
`decisions` entries containing id, method, status, reason, snapshot_indices and
SHA-bound evidence including the actual state screenshots. A visual pass requiring
`coverage:full_content` is withheld if interval coverage is incomplete. A visible
failure may be established from a smaller observed region. Manual judgment remains
fallible; typed runtime facts cannot be replaced with manual/source assertions.

Exit0 means supplied atomic assertions passed,1 confirmed assertion failures,
3 unassessed assertions,2 invalid inputs/evidence. This is not proof of every business
requirement absent an independently checked complete contract. Always retain the
assertion denominator and unassessed counts.

# Contract-bound visual observations and shared acceptance

Use this when visual findings must be auditable against an independent design.
The approved base contract still compiles through `design_contract.py`. Each
manual rule checks one aspect, rather than a sentence combining colors, wrapping,
hierarchy and state. See the complete [neutral example](../assets/atomic-example/).

An independent owner pins a separate `policy.json` canonical SHA256 alongside the
design lock SHA256 before implementation. It names each manual rule exactly once,
its single aspect/method, and the component/host/system responsibility of its
logical target. Visual Boolean propositions come from exact typed source pointers
in the same sealed design, so `actual:true` answers an explicit approved question.
Rendered color atoms use opaque source-backed ARGB. A canvas rule must specify
which layer paints the sampled region; an ambiguous owner is a design issue to
resolve before scoring. Hashes do not establish design correctness or authorship.

## Submit actual observations, not rewritten expectations

```sh
python3 scripts/review_contract.py catalog --plan generated/plan.json \
  --design-lock approved-lock.json --design-sha256 LOCK_SHA \
  --policy policy.json --policy-sha256 POLICY_SHA --platform ios \
  --output catalog.json
```

The catalog provides opaque stable `review_id` identities, original assertion IDs,
targets, explicit propositions, generated expected values/units/operators and
source provenance. Save the catalog digest from its `catalog_sha256` field.

The reviewer submits only:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "catalog_sha256": "CANONICAL_CATALOG_SHA",
  "observation_sha256": "EXACT_ORIGINAL_FILE_SHA",
  "decisions": [
    {"review_id": "FROM_CATALOG", "actual": true,
     "reason": "What the original captured state actually shows",
     "snapshot_indices": [3, 4]}
  ]
}
```

Only qualitative atoms accept Boolean/unknown actuals. Missing decisions remain
unassessed. No `expected`, `unit`, `status`, operator or target override is accepted.
Screenshot identities, state/input/action epochs and actual artifacts are checked;
the tool generates evidence hashes, findings and the manual input for native checks.

```sh
python3 scripts/review_contract.py review --plan generated/plan.json \
  --design-lock approved-lock.json --design-sha256 LOCK_SHA \
  --policy policy.json --policy-sha256 POLICY_SHA --platform ios \
  --observation run/observation.json --submission observations.json \
  --output new-review
```

The output contains `catalog.json`, `manual.json`, `findings.json`, `report.json`.
`native_checks.py` can consume the bound manual with `--review-policy` and
`--review-policy-sha256`, together with the independent design lock arguments.
It reconstructs the bundle from its original requests and images. A changed
expected, status, artifact, rationale or stripped binding is rejected. Keep the
policy digest outside the implementation-edited output, just like the design lock.

## What rendered-color evidence establishes

Pixel rules operate automatically on every eligible coherent state frame. The
independent sampling policy fixes a normalized rectangle inside a uniquely
resolved native semantic/control box, minimum support and pixel count, explicit
RGB channel tolerance, and fully-visible versus visible-fragment scope. The
tool recomputes native-to-PNG mapping, clips to the actual viewport, and records
the original PNG SHA256, native selector/box, pixel region and full histogram.
It never accepts AI-entered observed RGB values or chooses samples by closeness
to the expected color. RGB tolerance is not distance between packed ARGB integers.

The assertion concerns the dominant rendered sRGB in that approved region. A
region meant to measure solid fill must be independently suitable for that role;
glyph ink, an overlaid child or a gradient may make it uninformative. Insufficient
support, conflicting values, missing mapping or unsupported color profiles stay
unknown. An eligible visible frame with unavailable measurement blocks a pass even
if another frame matches; an explicit new native viewport packet never falls back
to legacy geometry when its node mapping is missing. State/input identities and
after-capture epoch bindings must agree for all accepted evidence. Transparent expectations need a separate approved compositing model.
This is not a generic computed SwiftUI font/color/padding API, whole-canvas proof,
or physical hit-area measurement. Existing unsupported native-style cells remain.

## Reliable independent acceptance

`acceptance.py` is a shared evaluator, not an extra treatment benefit. An external
environment contract fixes native dimensions, direction, theme and platform font
configuration; known Compose wire aliases are explicit. Unsupported/mismatched
environments gate acceptance to unknown while preserving raw facts.

For iOS its fields are `width`, `height`, `direction`, `theme`, `dynamic_type`;
the current thin host offers an explicit width and a fixed600pt viewport height.
Android uses `font_scale` in place of `dynamic_type`. Dimensions default to exact
native units. The pinned Paparazzi host additionally supports an explicitly
approved `dimension_encoding: "paparazzi-float32-screen-config-v1"`: `width` and
`height` then mean requested dp. The evaluator verifies the host's Float32 input,
Float32 multiplication by the pinned2.75 device density, truncation to integer
screen pixels, actual native viewport/density, and serialized Float32 dp output.
Requested390dp may thus produce1072px and389.81818dp, while each value remains
visible in the proof. This is a provider-specific input conversion, not a product
layout tolerance. Missing native metadata stays U and another encoding is rejected.
See the platform environment files in the neutral example. Its example approval
contains their canonical digests; a real design needs its own independent approval.

For qualitative atoms give two independently scoped contexts the same original
anonymous evidence and approved catalog, without each other's answers. Each
returns `{ "review": <submission above>, "attributions": [...] }`. A failure
attribution contains only `id`, `cause` (`product`, `infrastructure`, `observation`,
`uncertain`), `reason`, and original state `snapshot_indices`. Artifact hashes are
generated by the tool. The CLI requires both judge files and a separately pinned
environment file/digest alongside the plan, policy, lock and observation arguments.

```sh
python3 scripts/acceptance.py --plan generated/plan.json \
  --design-lock approved-lock.json --design-sha256 LOCK_SHA \
  --policy policy.json --policy-sha256 POLICY_SHA --platform ios \
  --observation run/observation.json --environment environment.ios.json \
  --environment-sha256 ENV_SHA --judge-one independent-one.json \
  --judge-two independent-two.json --output acceptance.json
```

Validated native/pixel statuses cannot be voted away. Qualitative judgments must
agree, otherwise the result stays unknown. A strict measured failure does not
automatically establish a product bug: for component-owned targets both independent
cause assessments must agree; missing or disputed attribution stays uncertain.
Host/system responsibility remains explicit. Keep raw judgments, strict F,
disagreements, supported product clusters and schema rejection as separate records.
AI agreement is not human gold and may share systematic errors.

Report true product alarms separately from report-schema/identity rejection.
Never repair a sealed original finding after seeing acceptance answers. Same-cause
manifestations and unrelated experiments must not be pooled as independent bugs.

# State evidence planning

Use this when selected business states require several independent native facts,
especially after a caller replacement or when related targets are far apart.
The caller agent chooses relevant states and translates the independent design.
The compiler checks that declared matrix; it cannot establish that prose has
been translated completely or that a supplied expectation/source is correct.

## Compile before feedback

Write a matrix with `version:1`, `states`, `requirements`, `required_state_ids`
and `required_requirement_ids`. Every selected state × requirement becomes a
cell. A requirement names its source and an atomic native check. A constant
`check.expected` applies across selected states; `by_state` can override expected,
target, action_index, stimulus, required_method or op. Without a default, every
applicable state needs its own expected value. `not_applicable` maps state IDs to
nonempty reasons; those cells remain in the ledger for independent review.

```json
{
  "version":1,
  "required_state_ids":["after-request","after-replacement"],
  "required_requirement_ids":["status","action-enabled"],
  "states":[
    {"id":"after-request","input_index":0,"after_action":0,"coverage":"targets"},
    {"id":"after-replacement","input_index":1,"after_action":1,"coverage":"targets"}
  ],
  "requirements":[
    {"id":"status","source":"Independent public status contract",
     "check":{"kind":"control","target":{"identifier":"actual.status"},
              "property":"label","expected":"Ready"},
     "by_state":{"after-replacement":{"expected":"Paused"}}},
    {"id":"action-enabled","source":"Independent enablement contract",
     "check":{"kind":"control","target":{"identifier":"actual.action"},
              "property":"enabled","expected":true},
     "by_state":{"after-replacement":{"expected":false}}}
  ]
}
```

```sh
python3 scripts/state_plan.py --matrix matrix.json --actions original-actions.json \
  --output fresh-plan
```

`plan.json` contains every applicable atomic check and required ID, plus a
SHA-bound declared matrix/disposition ledger. `actions.json` adds exact state
names and deduplicated `after_targets` from relevant checks. It preserves action
routes and callback requests; it adds no business expectation to the observer.
The output directory must be fresh. Original action names that disagree with
the matrix are rejected. A state can use `stimulus_action` to identify an earlier
requested stimulus separately from its explicit full-sweep observation action.

Choose actual producer state IDs and action indices. Initial and explicit sweep
states may use `coverage:"full_content"`. Other actions use `coverage:"targets"`.
Compilation does not insert full sweeps or establish missing native capabilities.
Preserve the matrix and plan before reviewing rendered feedback; changing an
expectation later needs a separate requirement reason, not a better test score.

## Collect and judge

Run the native observer with the generated actions, then `native_checks.py` with
the generated plan. The observer records the immediate action result and original
callback interval, then observes each target. Native frames can jointly establish
facts for targets that cannot fit in one viewport. All frames must have the exact
same native input/process/event binding. Input drift, wrong state/action, torn
image/hierarchy captures and conflicting values remain U.

Only actual matching native facts earn a verdict. The producer's
`all_targets_observed:true` flag alone is not evidence. Unseen targets cannot prove
absence without complete native full-content coverage. An oversized target may
have its center observed while full visibility remains false. Joint target frames
never establish complete content, effective padding/fonts or physical hit areas.

Callbacks still require demonstrated requested dispatch. Current labels and
enabled/selected native facts are separate observations; a label after a blocked
action is not proof that its handler executed or that zero callbacks passed.

The check report retains all failed and unassessed IDs and exports
`machine_findings` for failed typed-native checks, one record per actual state and
aspect. Preserve this report with its observation hash in the agent's review.
Keep manual visual findings separate; duplicate root causes can be grouped for
repair while their distinct state checks remain visible. A later shared repair
does not retroactively establish that another state was reviewed or detected.

Multi-target navigation costs additional work. Limit targets to the independently
planned aspects relevant to that state and retain the shared scroll budget,
unavailable targets, full-state coverage and command wall time. Do not shrink
content, bypass required states or drop U rows to improve coverage or speed.

# Native geometry precision and cohort barriers

Android observation retains each matched SemanticsNode's actual integer pixel
size, Float position promoted without another Float operation, and native density
promoted to Double. `native_geometry` contains version1, provider
`compose_semantics_int_size`, coordinate_unit px, density, position_px, size_px.
The observer keeps the original rounded bounds as well; neither replaces the other.

`native_geometry.py` computes dimensions directly from integer extents/native
density. Same-frame gaps/insets use recorded native positions and extents with
exact rational operations. iOS reads CGRect width/height directly, avoiding
x+width-x cancellation. Reports retain actual values, exact numerator/denominator,
provider, source samples, selectors and snapshot indices. The approved expectation
and its separately sourced design tolerance are unchanged. There is no global
epsilon, pixel snapping, nearest accepted size or implicit physical-pixel tolerance.
Actual layout quantization remains observable; a design allowing it must state an
independent tolerance before implementation.

The upstream public AX provider can itself report near-boundary floating values
or transient dimensions while scrolling or settling. Direct CGRect evidence does
not certify that provider accuracy. Preserve such failures/conflicts and separate
them from confirmed product defects; do not silently round them into passes.

This repairs export/subtraction precision; it does not recover unknown SwiftUI
computed styles, unobserved boxes, layout allocation, glyph ink or OS touch regions.
Two unique fully visible boxes must share a coherent native frame for a relation.
Real conflicting geometry within a state stays unassessed. Unknown/malformed native
packets never fall back to a reassuring rounded result. Legacy observations without
these samples keep the original strict calculation, explicitly labeled legacy;
reacquire native evidence before claiming precision improvement. Historical grades
and screenshots must not be overwritten.

For a multi-candidate validation, `cohort_gate.py` seals all configured members
at once and checks exact prerequisites and artifact hashes before launch. Fix a
version1 config with artifact_root and stage graph (`members`, `requires`) before
work. `seal(registry, stage, member_to_file_list)` rejects missing members,
unsealed upstream stages, changed artifacts, path escapes and duplicate seals.
`authorize(registry, stage)` returns a timestamped digest-bound receipt only when
the whole upstream cohort is complete. CLI equivalents accept --registry, --stage,
--artifact-root for relocated archives, and --members for a JSON mapping.

The caller still checks actual workspace source against its sealed capsule and
records the authorization receipt before invoking the SDK. A barrier is a process
guard, not a secure sandbox against direct SDK invocation or a declaration that
maliciously omits cohort members. Pin cohort membership before design, preserve
rejected early-launch controls and audit actual command times against seals.
